import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import itov
from itov.cli import main
from itov.comfyui import ComfyUIClient
r=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-09b-parallel-20260921.json').read_bytes())
v=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-09b-verification-20260921.json').read_bytes())
root=Path(itov.__file__).parent
assert 'site-packages' in str(root) and sys.version_info[:2]==(3,11)
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/Path(p).name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in v['source_sha256'].items())
calls=[]
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):
    calls.append(str(args));raise AssertionError('Completed replay attempted HTTP')
ComfyUIClient._json=forbidden
assert main(['parallel','resume',r['plan_path'],'--json'])==0
assert not calls
print('Installed Python 3.11 CLI: completed two-worker replay, zero HTTP, 33-module parity')
